title: Find the youngest driver among all race winners, and return their full name
question: Find the youngest driver among all race winners, and return their full name, nationality, and the fastest lap time (if recorded) from their first winning race.

WITH winners AS (
  SELECT res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
         MIN(r.XCL_070) AS first_win_date
  FROM results AS res
  INNER JOIN races AS r ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
  WHERE res.XCL_079 = 1
  GROUP BY res.XCL_075
),
youngest AS (
  SELECT w.driver_id,
         w.first_win_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC) AS rn
  FROM winners AS w
  INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = w.driver_id
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 AS forename,
       d.XCL_039 AS surname,
       d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
       res.XCL_088 AS fastest_lap_time
FROM youngest AS y
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = y.driver_id
INNER JOIN results AS res ON res.XCL_075 = y.driver_id
INNER JOIN races AS r ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
WHERE y.rn = 1
  AND r.XCL_070 = y.first_win_date
  AND res.XCL_079 = 1
LIMIT 1
